verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is automated full exports, set up via Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule. That is a recurring job, but a single fixed-purpose one. Nothing shows general-purpose scheduled workflows: the AI assistant plans multi-step work only interactively and needs approval, and the API/MCP integrations need external schedulers. missing for 10: user-defined recurring workflows or automations, scheduled AI/agent runs, triggers beyond export, independent corroboration.
